props.name: open
props.description: Open state. Two-way by default — use `bind:open`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state, for when `open` is not supplied.

props.name: controlledOpen
props.description:
Opt into fully controlled state: the component stops writing back to `open` and
only reports through `onOpenChange`, so the parent can reject a change by not
flowing the new value back down. Off by default, because `bind:open` — the
common case — needs the write-back to work at all.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when the open state changes.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the panel is anchored to.

props.name: modal
props.description: Focus trap / scroll lock behaviour. See `DrawerModal`.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether a swipe toward the anchored edge may dismiss the drawer.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape closes the drawer.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether pressing outside the panel closes it.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Resting positions the panel may settle on, smallest offset first is not
required — they are sorted internally. See `DrawerSnapPoint` for the accepted
value forms. Without this the drawer is either fully open or closed.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: Active snap point. Two-way by default — use `bind:snapPoint`.

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: Initial snap point, for when `snapPoint` is not supplied.

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description: Callback when the active snap point changes.

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description:
Stops a fast flick from skipping past the neighbouring snap point. Use it when
every step is meaningful and jumping two at once would disorient.

props.name: handle
props.description:
Drives the drawer from a detached handle instead of the `open` prop, so
triggers can live anywhere in the tree. See `createDrawerHandle`.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element. Set manually or via Drawer.Trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Children snippet, receiving state helpers.

props.name: children
props.description: Button label.

props.name: element

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the panel.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the panel.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description:
Where focus lands when the drawer opens. Defaults to the first focusable
element inside the panel.

props.name: touchAction
props.description:
`touch-action` for the panel. Defaults to `pan-y` for left/right drawers —
children keep scrolling vertically while the horizontal axis is reserved for
the drag — and to nothing for top/bottom ones, where reserving the vertical
axis would break every scrollable region inside (`touch-action` intersects
down the ancestor chain, so a child cannot opt back in).

dataAttributes.name: data-drawer-bleed
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the strip painted just outside the anchored edge, which covers the page while the panel is stretched past fully open.

dataAttributes.name: data-drawer-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the panel.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting

dataAttributes.name: data-expanded
dataAttributes.description: Present at the most open snap point.

dataAttributes.name: data-nested-drawer-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while a drawer opened after this one is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-nested-drawer-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while that nested drawer is being dragged.

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-direction

dataAttributes.name: data-swipe-dismiss
dataAttributes.description: Present once a swipe has dismissed the drawer, through its exit.

dataAttributes.name: data-swiping
dataAttributes.description: Present while a drag is in flight. Drop your transitions under it.
